title: SignatureProof
description: SAIA-Class S cryptographic signature proof used for credentials, identity verification, registry anchoring, and document authenticity within Beast System 3.0.

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm used (e.g., SHA-256, Ed25519, secp256k1).

publicKey.description: Public key associated with the signature (hex or base58).

signedAt.description: Timestamp when the signature was generated.

payloadHash.description: Hash of the signed payload (SHA-256 recommended).

issuerId.description: Identity ID of the signer (sovereign, delegate, or system).

verificationMethod.description: Method or key reference used to verify the signature (e.g., DID URL, DAO registry key).
